# DoorDash opportunity

## Press Release

The share of low-quality DoorDash menus fell by roughly 30% relative to baseline according to the [DoorDash case study](https://www.appliedcompute.com/case-studies/doordash).

## FAQ

### Why believe this?

The result is company-reported, so it is useful directional evidence rather than an independent causal result.
